source_title: Assistant Fitness Manager at EōS Fitness — West Bunghmun, Mizoram, India | LinkedIn Jobs - LinkedIn India
source_excerpt:
See who EōS Fitness has hired for this role
Ensure daily targets are met, particularly during weekends or when the Fitness Manager is not present, by leading the team and driving sales initiatives.
Drive sales by promoting personal training packages and building strong rapport with members.
Achieve sales targets for personal training services and small group training sessions, consistently meeting or exceeding performance goals.
Collaborate with the membership sales team to support new member onboarding, driving sales initiatives, and establishing a smooth transition into the club experience.
Conduct personalized welcome workouts for new members to evaluate their fitness needs and goals.
Guide new members through their initial club experience, fostering a positive, supportive environment that promotes personal training sales, member retention and engagement.
Facilitate professional development for personal trainers through regular coaching sessions and continuous support.
Effectively communicate goals, expectations, and procedures to staff members, ensuring everyone understands their roles and responsibilities.
Supervise the maintenance and cleanliness of the facility, including equipment, locker rooms, and common areas.
Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, maintaining proper certifications, and implementing safety protocols.
2-3 years of customer service experience.
Prior experience or strong interest in the fitness industry.
Strong communication skills, both verbally and in writing, for interacting with members, personal training clients, employees, management, and vendors.
Excellent relationship building and influencing skills with people at all levels and in all functions.
Strong detail orientation; systematic and thorough approach to problem solving; and good time management, organizational, and record-keeping skills.
Prior experience or strong interest in the fitness industry is a plus.
And, of course, someone who embraces our Core Values!
Must be available to work nights and weekends.
Must have a valid Personal Training certification
CPR certification required within 30 days of hire.
Ability to work in a gym setting; move about gym floors and rooms; communicate with employees, members, and the public
Ability to bend routinely and repetitively to lift more than 40 lbs.
Ability to access and operate the Company computer system including preparing documents, entering data into computer system, read reports from a computer data base or email system
Variable income opportunities including commission and bonus
A highly energetic and collaborative team.
A management team that cares about your professional development.
Free membership for you and plus one family member.
Discounted Personal Training, and merchandise – including supplements.
Daily Pay offered - access your funds before payday.
Competitive pay plus vacation, holiday, and sick pay.*
Group Health, dental, vision, Supplemental Life, and Employee Assistant Program are offered!*
Personal education growth options with Sophia Learning.
Based on eligibility of tenure and full-time vs. part-time employment.
Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at EōS Fitness by 2x
